direction: Evolve `score_merge_static` as a global depot-distance-scale normalized generalized savings rule: score = (d0i+d0j - lam*dij + mu*|d0i-d0j|)/mean(d0[1:]) + beta*clip((qi+qj)/Q,0,1), with lam in [1.00,1.15], mu in [0.08,0.15], beta in [0.05,0.15], plus an optional demand-balance term 1-|qi-qj|/(qi+qj). Forbid any per-pair local normalization (d0i+d0j-dij)/(d0i+d0j). Prefer a slightly more fill-aggressive variant than the M2 fixed-strong config since the cheap relocate_2opt post-pass can repair the tail fragments that aggressive capacity-fill merging creates.

operations.mechanism: KB `method-cvrp-m2-l2a-generalized-savings` establishes the verified, scale-invariant (0.00% drift at 1e-3 rescaling) global-scale generalized savings form and bounds lam/mu/beta, plus its explicit unconfirmed item: L2a was always evaluated with postprocess_mode='none', so pairing the evolved merge start with relocate_2opt is an untested residual-gain question this round can answer. `evidence-cvrp-m2-perpair-scale-normalization-antipattern` hard-constrains the hook against per-pair normalization (which regressed dev_24 to 16.66-18.08 by destroying far-from-depot radial priority), so the direction keeps a single global denominator mean(d0[1:]). Since the hook costs <0.4 ms and full solves are ~10-12 ms at n=200, the 500 ms budget supports relocate_2opt without truncation risk, and the KB's L2a weak regime is exactly the missing inter-route relocate layer that the post-pass supplies.

Success criterion: mean tour length on cvrp_dev_hetero_24 < 16.1398 with zero scale-invariance drift (1e-3 rescaling) and no budget truncation.
